text:
maya_finance: Heads-up: launching Tier Pilot next week. Need clarity on exemptions for long-standing customers and invoice handling for legacy credits. cc @ajeet_revenue @sophia_ops
ajeet_revenue: Quick q — is this an A/B (new tier) test or wholesale pricebook swap?
maya_finance: A/B. Test is 'tier-v2' uplift vs control. Exemptions: any contract signed before 2022-01-01 with committed spend > $5k/mo should remain on legacy unless they explicitly opt-in. Need sign-off from finance leads + legal.
sophia_ops: For billing, we should do shadow invoices alongside live. We'll reconcile before finalizing. Any preferences for charge code?
ben_billing: I can run shadow invoice feed. Note: vendor (Vertex Cloud) bumped their egress-equivalent rate ~6% starting next billing cycle — affects cost basis. Do we pass that through or absorb for the pilot?
maya_finance: For the pilot we absorb to keep customer experience consistent. But if a customer's delta > $50 we'll issue a credit. We also need a migration CSV to map old->new tiers. Example snippet:
```
account_id,old_tier,new_tier,legacy_granted_credit
12345,pro,pro-v2,0
67890,enterprise,enterprise-exempt,500
```
ajeet_revenue: :thumbsup: Maya, can you produce the eligible-customer list by EOD? I'll draft the exception approval flow (email + checkbox).
sophia_ops: I can run the shadow invoices for week-of rollout but we must avoid creating duplicates. Use charge_code `TPILOT23` and invoice note 'Pilot: tier pricing test'.
ben_billing: Important gotcha: a lot of invoices are already in pre-bill for March. Re-running billing will create drafts unless we void earlier drafts. I'll coordinate with eng-ops to avoid dupes. I'll also tag vendor_delta on affected line items.
pricing-bot: Reminder: pricing approval required from finance-leads. Current approvers: @maya_finance, @ajeet_revenue, @ralph_legal
maya_finance: I'll post the Google sheet with the list + mapping. We also need an API flag `tier_pilot_exempt` to mark opt-outs — @ajeet_revenue can you add that to flag config?
ajeet_revenue: Yes — I'll configure the feature flag: rollout 90% pilot / 10% control, cap total uplift at $50k/mo. Will wire in approval flow for legacy exceptions.
ben_billing: Action items: 1) ben to run shadow invoices & tag vendor deltas; 2) sophia to run preflight + avoid duplicate drafts; 3) maya to publish eligible list & mapping sheet; 4) ajeet to configure flags + approval flow. Anything missing?
sophia_ops: Legal needs to sign off on contract opt-in language. pinging @ralph_legal for heads-up.
maya_finance: Thanks all. If no blockers we'll flip shadow run Wed 10:00 PST and a small live canary Fri 08:00 PST. Post any urgent blockers here. :sparkles:
